newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume dives on rising prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume dives on rising prices.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dived to 594 kg on Friday, from Thursday's 1,108 kg, on weak demand caused by higher prices ahead of the weekend, dealers said.

Gold closed up in dollar terms at $347.50 an ounce, from $345.50 on Thursday, following the upward trend in world markets. Lira prices were also higher at 1,516,900 lira per gram, versus 1,506,100 lira.
The rise in lira terms was limited by a firmer Turkish currency which closed at 136,130 against the dollar, compared to 136,390 at Thursday's close on a lower dollar/mark parity.
Most of the day's trade -- 389 kg -- took place in the morning session and 78.9 percent of the total traded was in lira terms.
